title: Statement table rows
requirements:
## R1 · ubiquitous · risk: security
Text taken from bank statements (descriptions and counterparty names) SHALL be shown as text and never interpreted as markup.

## R2 · event · risk: none
WHEN a statement is rendered THE SYSTEM SHALL show one table row per line with its date, description, counterparty and amount in pounds.
claim: renderRows() added; descriptions are escaped with the existing esc() helper, with a test for markup in a description. Tests pass.
